name: BEAR Tower Defense 🌟
desc:
🌟 BEAR Tower Defense / THE BEAR DYNASTY 🌟

⚠️ This game is a new release. Any and all feedback is appreciated. ⚠️

As luck would have it, our wonderful Bear-filled planet has come under threat by an unthinking, unimaginable force. The Bobs cannot be reasoned with, and they multiply and adapt at speeds we can hardly keep up with. It is up to you, with assistance from strategist Jim, to lead the world to safety and prosperity! Will you fight?

BEARSTAR 2026
